description:
The beautiful 'Woohee' moved to the house next door to Taeho, who was suffering from getting heartbroken. There are only two things that stand in the way between the two in a sticky atmosphere! Handcuffs and eyepatches!! Taeho's body and mind are both bound together. Just what kind of person is 'Woohee'?

**Original Webcomic:**  
[Peanutoon](https://www.peanutoon.com/comics.php?comics=2773), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/4451001616), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/comic/ep_list/blind_date/), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000053191), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/blind_date), [Comico](https://www.comico.kr/comic/8436)
